title: lepturus simplex
intro: Lepturus simplex, commonly known as sprangletop or buffalo grass, is a type of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions around the world. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Lepturus simplex include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its potential to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections.
